lead.headline: Tuten missed Thursday, and his only cover locks at noon
lead.deck: Limited Wednesday, DNP Thursday. If he misses Friday too, or is listed doubtful, start Rice before 12:00.
lead.body: Bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten did not practise Thursday after a limited Wednesday with his ankle and foot. Woody Marks is out tonight with the concussion, Josh Jacobs is out and on bye, and Rice and Odunze kick off at 12:00 — so nobody can replace Tuten at Jacksonville's 13:55 inactives. The rule tightens: if he misses Friday's practice too, or is listed doubtful or out, move Gordon to RB and start Rice before noon; otherwise start Tuten. Jonathan Taylor opens your week tonight at Houston with no designation, but the Colts plan to use McGowan heavily too. Rice practised in full again; Geno Smith, Wilson's quarterback, says he intends to start.

doFirst.headline: One rule for Sunday
doFirst.deck: Tuten starts unless he misses Friday too or is listed doubtful/out — then Rice, before noon.
doFirst.note: Friday's Jaguars report is the trigger; at 13:55 nobody eligible is left.
doFirst.empty: Nothing to do before Friday's report.
